Asset type: finished individual character illustration for a trading card game. Portrait 2:3, 1024x1536, opaque full-bleed illustration.
Primary request: render the requested character alone in the pose from the supplied two-person scene, using the character sheet as the authority for face, hair and costume. Draw a new coherent whole-frame polished Japanese anime illustration, with fine confident clean linework, appealing exact character likeness, sophisticated cel shading, luminous effects, beautiful fabric folds and clearly readable anatomy. A premium anime trading card illustration, not a montage, sheet, model turn-around, or mockup.
MANDATORY NAME SPACE: leave the entire TOP 22% of canvas (y=0–338 at 1536px) as quiet, continuous, low-contrast dark navy cosmic background only. No head, hair, raised hand, device, bright effect, wings, panels or any foreground objects in that upper band. The highest foreground object starts below y=355. This space is for a later HTML name overlay. Seamlessly integrate the upper background with the rest; no blank white strip, rectangle, banner, graphic name plate, hard seam or card frame.
Show the one character's full body, head, both hands, complete device and both boots entirely inside the canvas, in the lower 76%, large and readable with an energetic broad-legged stance, three-quarter frontal camera as in the scene reference. Slight foreshortening in the reaching hand. Preserve the precise gesture and left/right limb assignments stated below. Do not mirror. Dramatic cosmic stage with fine light trails and tiny stars BELOW the name zone, consistent scale and crisp detailed rendering. No text, lettering, name, numbers, logos, watermark, border, stats, UI or other people.
Input image 1: character identity and outfit reference ONLY, Aria Luce character sheet. Use the large transformed front-view design. Input image 2: pose, held-device, gesture, lighting and background reference ONLY. Depict only the orange-haired girl on the LEFT of image 2, as a standalone card composition.
Subject: Aria Luce, youthful cheerful heroine; warm golden-orange eyes, high orange ponytail with a gold/teal V ornament, soft coral-to-aqua gradient at the ends and framing locks; same friendly anime face as sheet, exuberant confident open-mouth smile. Orange diamond gems at collar and waist, flowing overlapping long orange/coral and aqua/teal translucent leaf-like skirt tails; ivory knee-high heeled boots with gold edges. Teal fitted gloves as in the pose reference for the two hand gestures.
POSE: her RIGHT arm (viewer LEFT) is raised diagonally forward-up, elbow slightly bent, teal-gloved hand firmly gripping the vertical silver U-shaped fork device in the reference: short dark/teal handle, gold/orange diamond in its neck, upright U-shaped silver head with short orange horizontal resonator bars between tips. Keep this entire device below y=355 and uncut, with its top around y=370. Her LEFT arm (viewer RIGHT) is bent forward at chest height, hand facing the camera palm-out, five individually readable teal-gloved fingers spread in an open casting gesture. Feet planted far apart, one knee slightly bent; tilted energetic torso and flowing skirt tails. The head, hand angles, reach and leg stance must clearly recall the LEFT figure of the pose reference, adapted into the lower portrait region.
Effects: exactly SIX separate curved luminous leaf-shaped blades/wings, THREE on each side of her, arranged in the pose reference's wide fan. Cream-white/gold light surfaces, warm orange stems, subtle pale-aqua edging, independent floating magical constructs. Each inner tip ends in open air with a visible dark background GAP from shoulders, arms, hair, back and clothing; do not attach to the body or create a wing harness. Space the six silhouettes so all six are countable. Gold and teal curved light ribbons flow behind and around her lower body, strong graceful outward arcs. The top name band remains dark and quiet.
Avoid other people, any Nox panels, oversized weapons, staff replacing the fork, leggings, inaccurate hair color, lost ponytail ornament, extra fingers or hands, attached physical wings, extra wings, any split-screen dividing line.
